recovery.scope: Memex DB via SQLite online backup; archive, journals, index and sync state; all current Codex sessions. Ephemeral locks/sockets/WAL/SHM and .log files excluded. Private snapshot and restored clone retained under ignored tmp/memory-integrity-20260908/recovery.
recovery.consistency: SQLite online backup is transaction-consistent. Cross-file/source capture is NOT_PROVEN atomic while writers run. Offline drill verifies bytes and DB integrity; original absolute path mappings must be retained for an actual restore. Never replace live tombstones with an older snapshot.

limitations: Production data not modified; no archive reprocessing.
Synthetic deterministic regression baseline, not real-model accuracy measurement.
No coordinated writer pause; whole-root point-in-time recovery NOT_PROVEN.
